$comment: As of Claude Code's current hook schema (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks), hooks declared in a Skill's own frontmatter run only while that skill is active and are cleaned up automatically when it finishes. All six KRYLO gate/telemetry hooks (question-gate, risk-gate, posttool-telemetry, fingerprint, agent-events for SubagentStart/SubagentStop, stop-gate) are declared in plugins/krylo/skills/run/SKILL.md instead of here, so an ordinary Claude Code session that never invokes /krylo:run launches zero KRYLO hook processes. See docs/adr/0021-hook-scoping-to-run-skill.md. This file intentionally registers no plugin-wide hooks.
